name: Water — Dam Break (GPU Surface)
description: FLIP dam break with a GPU liquid surface: the Liquid Surface group turns each particle frame into an anisotropic level set and a marching-cubes mesh on the GPU, so Surface Detail and particle shape change the next frame without restarting the simulation. Live only; native whitewater as in Water — Dam Break.
